scripts.infra:ws:dev: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform workspace select dev || terraform -chdir=infra/terraform workspace new dev
scripts.infra:ws:prod: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform workspace select prod || terraform -chdir=infra/terraform workspace new prod
scripts.infra:destroy:dev: terraform -chdir=infra/terraform workspace select dev && terraform destroy -var-file=env/dev.tfvars
scripts.infra:package: npm run build && cp package.json package-lock.json dist/ && cd dist && npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && zip -r handler.zip . && cd ..
scripts.infra:package:api: npm run build && mkdir -p build/api && cp -r dist/* build/api/ && cp package.json package-lock.json build/api/ && cd build/api && npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && rm package.json package-lock.json && zip -r api.zip . && mv api.zip ../../dist/ && cd ../..
scripts.infra:package:s3: npm run build && mkdir -p build/s3EventHandler && cp -r dist/* build/s3EventHandler/ && cp package.json package-lock.json build/s3EventHandler/ && cd build/s3EventHandler && npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && rm package.json package-lock.json && zip -r s3EventHandler.zip . && mv s3EventHandler.zip ../../dist/ && cd ../..
scripts.infra:package:all: npm run infra:clean && npm run infra:package:api && npm run infra:package:s3
